Surface UX decisions from Jack Heart (2026-11-22) on Round 5 of `scratch/explore.html` ("1b 2b 3b 4a 5a 6a+c"):

- 1b — Outer chrome: Side rail listing open experiments and machines (with collapsed form for narrow screens/print).
- 2b — Experiments page (`/`): Cards with the headline curve (first panel of each experiment's `report()`, live, with a dot per run).
- 3b — Single-experiment control center (`/experiments/NAME`): Table of runs with detail pane beside it (Console / Curves / Config / Checkpoints, keeping the selected detail tab as you move across runs), plus Report.
- 4a — Machines page (`/machines`): Three tables — held now, waiting for a machine (queue), ended today.
- 5a — Reports browser (`/reports`): Index of reports (when built, commit `report()` is declared at, best score, runs drawn, saved copy path).
- 6a+c — Controls in the control center: (a) Cancel a run or all runs, and (c) Play waiting evals. (Earlier steer noted starting read-only for web sharing and adding admin controls later; confirm timing at ship-review.)
- Q7 (separate run page) not yet specified.
